__training_comment: training_input_file -> CSV with columns: smiles, consensus_score
consensus_pairs_file -> CSV with columns: smiles_a, smiles_b, consensus_choice (A/B)
top_k -> number of top OOF model/config pairs used in the stacking ensemble
__prediction_comment: prediction_input_file -> CSV with a single column: smiles
checkpoint_dir is set automatically by ./run_training.sh; leave empty before first training run.
__legacy_comment: model_type and variant are LEGACY -- only used when checkpoint_dir is empty.
